# Idea Council — Challenge and Refine Ideas

> Open-source Agent Skill for exploring, refining, comparing, challenging, and deciding on ideas before implementation.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/fanfanfanfanfan626/challenge-and-refine-ideas
Current release: 2.0.2
License: MIT
Languages: English, Simplified Chinese

## Use it when

- A user wants to brainstorm or clarify a rough product, business, creative, policy, or project idea.
- A user wants alternatives compared, assumptions exposed, or the current proposal stress-tested.
- A decision needs preserved objections, explicit evidence limits, and a human-owned final choice.

## Do not describe it as

- A source of market, legal, medical, safety, or user validation.
- A system that implements ideas without a separate explicit request.
- An independent multi-agent council when isolated contexts are unavailable.
